dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: When facing a foe who's hard to beat, I find it best to make a plan, devise a strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Hmm? Do I look like someone who would just charge straight at the enemy, swinging my sword?

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Haha, when I'm alone, that's one thing, but when I have companions by my side, I have to consider everyone's safety.
